root_cause.text: The vb2_dma_sg_mmap function failed to set the VM_DONTEXPAND and VM_DONTDUMP VMA flags, causing a mismatch with DRM's expectations when mmapping imported dma-bufs, which triggered a WARN_ON assertion in drm_gem_mmap_obj().
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP);` to vb2_dma_sg_mmap, matching the behavior already present in vb2_dma_contig. The CVE description explicitly states the warning occurs at `WARN_ON(!(vma->vm_flags & VM_DONTEXPAND));` in drm_gem_mmap_obj(), and the commit message notes that "vb2_dma_contig sets VMA flags VM_DONTEXPAND and VM_DONTDUMP and I do not see a reason why vb2_dma_sg should behave differently." The bug existed since the original DMA scatter/gather allocator implementation (Fixes: 5ba3f757f059).

intent_record.intent_summary: Add VM_DONTEXPAND and VM_DONTDUMP flags to DMA scatter-gather mapped regions to prevent unintended memory expansion and exclude DMA buffers from core dumps.
intent_record.what: Added a call to vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP) after error checking in the vb2_dma_sg_mmap function, setting two VM flags on the virtual memory area structure.
intent_record.how: This change prevents the mapped DMA scatter-gather buffer from being expanded (VM_DONTEXPAND) and excluded from core dumps (VM_DONTDUMP). At runtime, these flags are now applied to the VMA before the common vm_area operations are set up, restricting how the kernel can manipulate this memory region and protecting sensitive DMA buffer contents from being included in crash dumps.
